title: Central African health-worker three-day strike, 8–10 February
reason: The report documents a public-hospital work stoppage and explicit demands to the Central African government/health ministry, but not a public gathering of 50 or more. The union leader says personnel were at home, with minimum service, while she toured hospitals (line 45); the report does not establish a protest assembly. Excluded as a strike-only report for MM event coding; this does not prove no separate gathering occurred.
open_question: Search separate sources for any actual public assembly linked to the health dispute; strike reports alone do not establish an MM gathering.
notes: A strike is reported, but this body does not report a public protest gathering; retain as a relevant strike-only lead without claiming that no separate assembly occurred.
open_questions: Did a separate public assembly or street protest accompany the work stoppage? The source does not establish one.
